R2-CAPABILITIES-01.title: Task requirements envelope
R2-CAPABILITIES-01.outcome: Normalize supplied job requirements into required inputs, output constraints and acceptable evidence using existing capability contracts.
inputs: Current STATE and accepted source inventory
Owning repository current default plus explicit source pin
Supplied public or synthetic fixtures, never private customer material
acceptance: Runnable bounded artifact and focused tests, positive/negative/partial cases
Literal fresh-consumer instructions and truthful full demo
Exact feature-branch source and compact result
R2-CAPABILITIES-01.mutation: isolated source/tests and named feature branch; Root decides public release/account/spend
R2-CAPABILITIES-01.stop: Reuse an accepted equivalent instead of rebuilding; declare concrete missing inputs; no invented facts or quota filler
